scope: Targeted comparison: 10 original research articles, one FDA notice and one grouped NCI terminology reference; not a systematic review

sources.setting: MSI-H/dMMR metastatic CRC; nivolumab-ipilimumab versus nivolumab across lines; randomized phase 3
claims: PFS HR 0.62 (95% CI 0.48-0.81); median not reached versus 39.3 months. Grade 3-4 treatment-related adverse events 22% versus 14%.

data_dates.observation_period_or_follow_up: Enrollment August 16, 2019-April 10, 2023; cutoff August 28, 2024; median follow-up 47.0 months.

sources.publication_date_basis: Online publication unless date caveat states otherwise
sources.setting: Single-arm phase 2; early-stage dMMR rectal and nonrectal tumors amenable to curative-intent surgery
claims: All 49 rectal treatment completers had clinical complete response; 37 sustained it at least 12 months. Two-year RFS 92% (95% CI 86-99) refers to all 117 rectal and nonrectal patients.

data_dates.observation_period_or_follow_up: Analysis data December 2019-April 2025; median recurrence follow-up 20.0 months across full cohort.

inference_limits: Completer and enrollment denominators differ; single-arm selected cohort. The 92% is not a rectal-only cure rate or evidence in pMMR disease.

sources.setting: 500 previously treated metastatic PDAC patients; randomized phase 3
claims: Overall-population median OS 13.2 versus 6.7 months (HR 0.40); PFS 7.2 versus 3.6 months (HR 0.49). Dual primary endpoints were in RAS G12 population; overall-population endpoints were key secondary endpoints.

data_dates.observation_period_or_follow_up: Cutoff calendar date not verified in original abstract; print issue July 23, 2026.

sources.publication_date_basis: Online publication unless date caveat states otherwise
sources.setting: 44 selected phase 1/2 PDAC patients with paired ctDNA plus preclinical models
claims: 26/44 had acquired RAS-pathway alterations; mutant KRAS amplification occurred in 16/44. Combination results were preclinical.

data_dates.observation_period_or_follow_up: Paired pretreatment and end-of-treatment/progression samples; selected initial disease control with PFS >3 months; calendar cutoff not established in inspected sections.

inference_limits: Selected progressor sample does not estimate frequency in all treated patients. Alterations overlap; ctDNA assay sensitivity/shedding limits negative findings; combinations lack established human efficacy here.
